name: Google AI Studio
role: Primary Build Environment, Framework & Cloud Hosting
howIUseIt: My central command center. I use Google AI Studio both as my application framework and my instant cloud hosting platform—allowing me to iterate on full-stack code, preview live in the browser, and deploy directly to Cloud Run URLs.
samplePrompt: Build a multi-page portfolio with JSON data files, semantic HTML, calligraphic display typography, and PostGeneric-inspired subtle scroll animations.

name: Claude
role: Architecture Refinement, Code Explanations & Prompt Structuring
howIUseIt: I use Claude to dissect complex UI architectures, refine my build prompts for maximum clarity, and break down unfamiliar JavaScript patterns into clean, commented code that accelerates my learning.
samplePrompt: Explain how this state transition works step-by-step with beginner-friendly code comments, and help me structure a clean JSON schema for my portfolio data.

name: Gemini
role: Deep Research, Multimodal Context & High-Thinking Reasoning
howIUseIt: I use Gemini (including Gemini 4 Argon with High Thinking) for deep technical research, synthesizing large documentation sets, and powering intelligent server-side features inside my apps.
samplePrompt: Analyze the motion language of PostGeneric and synthesize a 60-30-10 dark-mode design specification with compositor-only CSS transitions.

name: ChatGPT
role: Rapid Ideation, Content Drafting & UX Copywriting
howIUseIt: When a raw idea strikes, I use ChatGPT to brainstorm user journeys, draft crisp editorial copy, explore edge cases, and turn rough thoughts into structured project briefs.
samplePrompt: Help me articulate my vibe coding philosophy—focusing on flow state, shipping hackathon prototypes before momentum fades, and continuous learning.

name: Semantic HTML, JavaScript & Tailwind CSS
howIUseIt: AI tools are only as good as the web fundamentals they output. I focus on clean semantic HTML5 (`<main>`, `<nav>`, `<article>`), modular JavaScript/TypeScript, and responsive Tailwind CSS.
samplePrompt: Ensure every interactive element uses native <button> or <a> tags, meets WCAG AA contrast, and includes clear educational comments.
